quote: A powerful (and perhaps expensive) language model like GPT-3 is used to create a modest number of synthetic queries.
An expensive LLM like GPT-3 is used to create an initial set of synthetic queries ... These queries are incorporated ... to generate large numbers of synthetic queries cheaply.

An expensive LLM like GPT-3 is used to create an initial set of synthetic queries. These are incorporated into a set of prompts for a less expensive LLM that can generate large numbers of synthetic queries cheaply.
We only use synthetic queries that pass this filter, which tests whether a synthetic query can return its gold passage within the top 20 retrieved results using a zero-shot ColBERTv2 retriever.
